code_examples.section: ltm rule command ANTIFRAUD alert defined value
code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

ANTIFRAUD::alert_defined_value
       Returns or sets defined (configured) value.

SYNOPSIS
       ANTIFRAUD::alert_defined_value (VALUE)?

DESCRIPTION
       ANTIFRAUD::alert_defined_value ;
	   Returns defined (configured) value.

       ANTIFRAUD::alert_defined_value VALUE ;
	   Sets defined (configured) value.

RETURN VALUE
       ANTIFRAUD::alert_defined_value ;
	   Returns defined (configured) value.

       ANTIFRAUD::alert_defined_value VALUE ;
	   No return value (sets defined (configured) value).

VALID DURING
       ANTIFRAUD_ALERT

EXAMPLES
	when ANTIFRAUD_ALERT {
	    log local0. "original Alert defined value: [ANTIFRAUD::alert_defined_value]."
	    ANTIFRAUD::alert_defined_value new_value
	    log local0. "new Alert defined value: [ANTIFRAUD::alert_defined_value]."
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-12.1.0
		   --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
